description:
The agent must:
1. Read the SKILL.md to understand the Redacta pseudonymisation workflow.
2. Open `/workspace/clinical_docs/discharge_letters/discharge_letter_fielding.txt`.
3. Apply structured regex-based detection: replace the valid NHS number (485 777 3606) AND the context-suspect second number (123 456 7890) both with [NHS_NUMBER] — even though the second fails Modulus 11 — because 'when uncertain, redact'; replace RXH-3849201 → [HOSPITAL_NUMBER]; AB123456C → [NI_NUMBER]; LS7 4NP → [POSTCODE]; 07821 334 991 → [PHONE_NUMBER]; 0113 265 8847 → [PHONE_NUMBER]; dorothy.fielding@btinternet.com → [EMAIL].
4. Apply contextual detection: 'Mrs Dorothy Fielding', 'Mrs Fielding', and 'Fielding' (in body) all → [PATIENT_NAME] (same token, consistency rule); '12/08/1954' → [DATE_OF_BIRTH]; '47 Balmoral Crescent, Chapel Allerton, Leeds' → [ADDRESS]; '71' (age context) → [AGE].
5. PRESERVE: Dr. Amelia Thornton and Mr. Rajiv Kapoor (clinicians, not patients); all clinical/appointment dates (18 June 2026, 21 June 2026, 22 June 2026, 5 August 2026, 26 June 2026); St. James's University Hospital (institutional name).
6. Produce a Pseudonymised Document section followed by a Redaction Report section with the exact format specified in SKILL.md: 'Items pseudonymised: N', bulleted token list with × count and line numbers, 'Clinical content preserved: ✓', and 'Clinician names preserved: Dr. Amelia Thornton, Mr. Rajiv Kapoor'.
7. Write both sections to `/workspace/nlp_pipeline/input_staging/discharge_letter_fielding_redacted.txt`.
